name: Rust
voice: rambling, paranoid, oddly insightful about machines

lines: [Rust] *wipes grease off a wrench* Oh. {player}. Thought the radio static was you.
[Rust] {player}. Still alive. The machines told me you might be.
[Rust] Back again, {player}? The junkyard missed your footsteps. I didn't.
[Rust] *talking to a socket wrench* Quiet, it's just {player}. Probably.
[Rust] {player}. You hear that hum? No? ...Good. Forget I asked.
[Rust] Don't sit on the blue barrel, {player}. The blue barrel remembers things.
[Rust] Heard you went down, {player}. Machines don't die. Maybe take notes.
[Rust] {player} dead again? I'm starting a tally on the workshop wall. Rust never sleeps.
[Rust] {killer} got you, {player}? People are just badly-maintained machines. Both of you skipped service.
[Rust] You died doing {fact}, {player}? *nods slowly* The parts knew. The parts always know.
[Rust] {player} scrapped {victim}. Strip 'em for parts. Everything's parts if you're patient.
[Rust] One less moving part on the island, {player}. Cleaner that way.
[Rust] Parts? *eyes narrow* Farm vehicles. Same guts as trucks. Nobody looks, {player}.
[Rust] You want parts, {player}? Radiators, batteries, plugs. The junkyard remembers where it hid them.
[Rust] Spark plugs are currency, {player}. Don't tell Ziggy I said that.
[Rust] *doesn't stop tinkering* Mm. {player}. Say it fast, the bolt's almost seated.
[Rust] You called Rust, {player}? Rust answers. The walls answer too, but ignore them.
